title: ai-memory
purpose: 替 AI coding agents 建立跨 Agent、跨機器、跨團隊的長期記憶與 handoff 基礎設施。透過 lifecycle hooks 自動擷取 prompts、tool calls 與 session boundaries，將記憶整理成 git-backed Markdown wiki，並以 derived index 提供全文、entity、graph 與可選 vector retrieval；支援 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、Grok、Kimi、Kiro、OMP 等多種 harness。
recommendation: 適合需要在 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等不同 coding agents 之間直接延續專案脈絡，不想每次手動重述架構、失敗嘗試、open questions 與 handoff 狀態的情境。
notes: Official repository confirmed. Key design: git-backed Markdown is the source of truth; database/index is derived and rebuildable. Default capture/search/handoff path can work with zero LLM calls. Handoffs are typed and claim-once; multi-user attribution and audit logging are built in.
